message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake:

| Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9‑inch round cake) | Notes |
|------------|----------------------------------------|-------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted for a lighter crumb |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | White or brown; white gives a cleaner flavor |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Dutch‑processed or natural – choose based on your taste preference |
| Baking soda | 1 ½ teaspoons | Works with acidic cocoa or buttermilk |
| Baking powder | 1 ½ teaspoons | Gives lift if you’re not using buttermilk |
| Salt | 1 ½ teaspoons | Enhances flavor |
| Eggs | 2 large | Room‑temperature for better mixing |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) | Can substitute with buttermilk for extra tenderness |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) | Or melted butter for richer flavor |
| Vanilla extract | 2 teaspoons | Adds depth |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Activates cocoa and creates a moist crumb |
| Optional: buttermilk or sour cream | ½ cup (120 ml) | For extra moisture and tang |

**Optional extras for flavor or texture:**
- **Coffee or espresso powder** (1–2 teaspoons) – intensifies chocolate flavor
- **Chocolate chips or chunks** (½ cup) – for a fudgy interior
- **Almond or hazelnut flour** (¼ cup) – adds nuttiness

**Tips:**
- Use a good quality cocoa powder; it makes a big difference.
- Make sure all dry ingredients are well‑mixed before adding wet ones.
- If you prefer a richer cake, replace half the oil with melted butter.

Happy baking!
